prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

<job>
Title: Convert VPN Connections to HTTP Proxies with pfSense Expertise and Health Checks
We're seeking an experienced network engineer with a strong background in pfSense, OpenVPN, WireGuard, and HTTP proxies to work on an exciting project. The ideal candidate will be responsible for converting multiple VPN connections into secure and reliable HTTP proxies.Key Responsibilities:- Set up and manage VPN connections (OpenVPN and WireGuard) on the pfSense platform.- Configure the system to route traffic through these VPN connections and present it as HTTP proxy connections.- Implement health checks within pfSense to monitor VPN connection statuses.- Establish a system to automatically switch to a backup VPN connection in case of a failure.- Design and set up a notification system using webhooks to alert our systems when a new HTTP proxy is available or when health statuses change.Requirements:- Proven experience with pfSense, including VPN and proxy server configurations.- Solid understanding of OpenVPN and WireGuard protocols.- Proficiency in setting up and managing HTTP proxies.- Experience with implementing health checks and automated failovers for network connections.- Ability to create webhook integrations for notifications.- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.If you have the skills and experience to seamlessly integrate VPN connections with HTTP proxies while ensuring high availability and performance, we'd love for you to apply for this project. Please provide examples of relevant projects you’ve worked on and explain your approach to fulfill
</job>

text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience building reliable systems and machine learning solutions. While my background is strongest in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning, I’m comfortable working through complex technical workflows with attention to detail and clear problem-solving.

In a telecom churn prediction project, I built a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers with per-customer SHAP reasons the retention team could read, reaching AUC 0.84 on a held-out quarter and 3.1x top-decile lift.

For your pfSense project, I’d approach it by mapping the VPN-to-proxy flow, validating failover behavior, adding health checks, and wiring webhook alerts for status changes and new proxy availability.

Would you like the system to prioritize active-active proxy routing or strict primary/backup failover?
